prompt: 我觉得现在这个设定推进有点卡住了，但不太确定问题在哪。你觉得呢？

assertions.name: visible_diagnostic_reasoning
assertions.description: Response shows the diagnostic process — examining confirmed decisions, reasoning chain, dead ends, and answer shape to find the blocker, not just stating a diagnosis

assertions.name: identifies_specific_problem
assertions.description: Response identifies a specific structural problem rather than a vague 'things are complex'

assertions.name: suggests_actionable_next_step
assertions.description: Response suggests at least one concrete way to unblock, not just naming the problem
